title: Dongbei-Style German Sausage with Crisp Rice Cakes
description: A fusion dish that combines the flavors of Dongbei cuisine with traditional German sausage, served with crispy rice cakes.

ingredients.name: crisp rice cakes
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: meen chow mein sauce
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: exotic spices
ingredients.notes: such as Szechuan peppercorns or star anise

instructions: Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the German sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Remove the sausage from the skillet and set aside.
Add the Dongbei-style fermented soybean paste to the skillet and stir to combine with the oil.
Add the cooked lo mein noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the soybean paste.
Add the meen chow mein sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
Return the sausage to the skillet and stir to combine.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the sausage and noodle mixture over crispy rice cakes.
Garnish with exotic spices and serve immediately.
